set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
EXPECTED="4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb"
BASE="30bff5c930e9cff13b52f9bff67dc3e21ea06798"
cd "$ROOT"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
git switch main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "RESTORING_EXACT_PRE_SPRINT_TREE $BASE"
git restore --source="$BASE" --staged --worktree -- .
git diff --cached --check
echo "FILES_REVERTED=$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
git diff --cached --stat
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -ge 30
cd frontend
npm run format:check
npm run test
npm run build
cd ..
git commit -m "revert(ux): restore PhotoMap pre-sprint version [skip ci]"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git diff --quiet "$BASE" HEAD
git push origin main
echo "ROLLBACK_MAIN_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "RESTORED_TREE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"
echo "PRE_SPRINT_TREE_SHA=$(git rev-parse "$BASE"^{tree})"
echo "SOURCE_ROLLBACK_PUSHED"
